what: the top rim of a cylinder r10 x 20 chamfered 10 across the top (the whole radius) and 3 down the wall: builds a cone to the centre
method: The chamfer's line in (rho, z) runs from (0, 20) on the axis to (10, 17) on the wall, so the top is taken whole and the cone ends in a point on the axis (the owner's ruling of 2026-10-30 (d7): a chamfer that reaches a rim builds). The result is the cone from the tip at z = 20 down to r 10 at z = 17 on top of the cylinder r 10 from z = 17 to z = 0: pi r^2 h / 3 + pi r^2 h = pi 100 3 / 3 + pi 100 17 = 100 pi + 1700 pi = 1800 pi = 5654.866776. Faces: the cone, the wall and the bottom: 3.
